item.title: Pork pie expert only finds one fault with Grantham product – but gets over it!
item.description: Pork Pie Appreciation Society reports Tastes great- decent amount of seasoning. Not loads of jelly, but the pastry is just the right thickness and nicely crispy. Very affordable price and I’d recommend them. As an aside, the shop was so busy I went for a pint before returning to purchase the pie.
